public.text: The adaptability principle supports ongoing evaluation but does not establish a formal review cadence, triggers for extraordinary review, or responsibility for implementing lessons.
public.suggestedRevision: Require periodic governance review and event-triggered review following major incidents, legal changes, significant architecture changes, supplier failure, material inequity findings, or persistent service-performance problems.
